calculate_nmse: calculate the normalized mean squared error between two numpy arrays of model logits
load_logits: load model logits from .npy, .bin, or text files into a numpy float32 array
interpret_nmse: interpret an NMSE value and return a human-readable quality description with emoji
run_nmse_check: run the check-nmse CLI tool to compare pytorch and llamacpp model conversion logits
validate_model_conversion: validate a model conversion by comparing reference and test logits with NMSE threshold
